fields.title: The DICTO OG Family: Four Steps Up and Four Down
fields.abstract: In Universal PiTet a single rule T builds each solid from the last: every corner v of a solid S gives the face plane v·x = v·v, through v and at right angles to the line from the centre, and T(S) is the solid these planes bound. Started at the icosidodecahedron it closes into a four-step cycle. DICTO proposed running it from the DICTO Ogdoecontahedron (OG), and also running it the other way. The reverse step P takes as new corners the foot points of S's face planes, the points of those planes nearest the centre. From the OG, four steps of T give four solids with 92, 180, 212 and 270 corners, the DICTO KRE, PHE, TPP and DPHP, and four steps of P give four with 80, 132, 140 and 162 corners, the DICTO TPH, TQH, TQP and TQHD. All eight are proved exactly in ℚ(√5), each with the full icosahedral symmetry, and each step of P is undone exactly by T. Several have regular faces: 12 regular pentagons (PHE, TPH, TQP), 20 regular hexagons (PHE, DPHP, TQH, TQHD); the KRE has 30 rhombi and 60 kites. The family does not cycle. It nests as shells for three steps up, OG ⊂ KRE ⊂ PHE ⊂ TPP, and two steps down, TQH ⊂ TPH ⊂ OG, and each of these shells, and also the shell TQHD ⊂ TQP, is filled exactly by one piece per face of the inner solid. Both directions then break in the same way: 60 corners of the TPP stand outside the DPHP, and 60 corners of the TQP outside the TQH. In the plane, T and P are the classical antipedal and pedal constructions; the polyhedral pedal construction was posed as an open problem in 2010. We found the eight solids in no source. Version 2 adds a harmonic fingerprint and the Dehn invariant: all nine solids have Q4 = Q8 = 0 and Ŵ6 = ±0.16975, the icosahedron's value up to sign (exact), the sign splitting them into corner type and face type; all nine have a nonzero Dehn invariant (exact for the OG, numerical for the other eight), so none fills space alone.
fields.ai_statement: DICTO proposed running the rule T from the DICTO Ogdoecontahedron and running it the other way, and (Version 2) the harmonic fingerprint; all eight names are DICTO's. Computation, exact checking and drafting were done with Claude (Anthropic). DICTO read and approved the typeset paper before release on Zenodo. No outside referee has checked it.
fields.process_summary: 20 Oct 2026: from DICTO's proposal, the rule T (corners to face planes) and its reverse P (face planes to their foot points) were run four steps each way from the Ogdoecontahedron in exact Q(sqrt5) arithmetic; the eight solids, their faces, volumes, nesting shells and the two breaks were derived and checked (studies/2026-10-19-five-fold-octet, research branch commit 058c2fb). Version 2 (7 Nov 2026) added the harmonic fingerprint and Dehn invariants (studies/2026-11-04-nest-fingerprint and the Dehn study).
fields.verification_notes: All corners, faces and volumes exact in Q(sqrt5); each step of P checked to be undone exactly by T; the shells and their one-piece-per-face fillings checked exactly. Version 2: Q4 = Q8 = 0 and W6 exact; Dehn invariant exact for the OG, numerical for the other eight (PSLQ screen calibrated on ten solids). Scripts and data: studies/2026-10-19-five-fold-octet (commit 058c2fb).
fields.negative_results: The family does not cycle; the nesting breaks after three steps up and two down (60 corners of the TPP outside the DPHP, 60 of the TQP outside the TQH). Prior-art search (80 library sources in full text, web searches 20 Oct 2026) found none of the eight solids.
